title: Interpret Dark Blue vs Light Blue Indicators on the Container Selection Screen
summary: Use the blue indicator color on the OptiSweep Container Selection screen to determine whether a station/location has a tote present (dark blue) or is an empty rack (light blue). After selecting the indicated item, verify the UI shows a box icon and the tote number when a tote is present.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly determine tote presence vs empty rack for a specific station/location shown on the Container Selection screen.
not_for: Do not guess tote presence if the indicator color meaning does not match what you observe after selection—stop and escalate.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the live check on the Container Selection screen and confirm tote presence/absence using the blue indicator color and the selection result (box icon + tote number).
L1_support: Assist by reviewing the selected station/location result and helping confirm whether the observed UI state is consistent with the expected dark-blue vs light-blue meaning.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Container Selection screen (HMI)

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing the small blue indicator on stations and the meaning: dark blue = tote present; light blue = empty rack; selection shows a box icon and tote number.

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen (totes/containers)
steps.purpose: Get to the live Container Selection display where the blue indicator color is shown for stations/locations.
steps.instruction: Open the Container Selection screen (totes/containers) in the OptiSweep HMI.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is visible and shows station/location entries with the small blue indicator on top of some stations.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the station/location tiles/entries and the small blue indicator associated with them.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot see the Container Selection screen or the blue indicator is not visible for the station/location you need to check.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “Container selection so you may have seen on on these there's a small blue thing on top of some of these stations.”

steps.title: Observe the blue indicator color for the station/location you are checking
steps.purpose: Determine tote presence vs empty rack using the documented dark-blue vs light-blue indicator meaning.
steps.instruction: For the station/location you are checking, look at the small blue indicator color on the Container Selection screen.
steps.expected_result: You can classify the station/location as either dark blue (tote present) or light blue (empty rack).
steps.healthy_condition: The indicator color is clearly visible as either dark blue or light blue for the station/location tile you selected to check.
steps.failure_condition: The indicator color is unclear or you cannot reliably distinguish dark blue vs light blue for the station/location.

actions.label: Check indicator color
actions.exact_action: Observe the blue indicator color: dark blue vs light blue.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “Dark blue indicates the presence of a tote. While light blue represents empty rack.”

steps.title: Interpret dark blue as “tote present”
steps.purpose: Apply the correct meaning to dark blue so you treat the location as having a tote.
steps.instruction: If the indicator is dark blue, treat the station/location as “tote present.”
steps.expected_result: Your working interpretation for that station/location is tote present.
steps.healthy_condition: The indicator is dark blue for the station/location you are checking.
steps.failure_condition: The indicator is not dark blue (e.g., it appears light blue) but you interpret it as tote present.

actions.label: Mark tote present
actions.exact_action: If the indicator is dark blue, treat it as “tote present.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “Dark blue indicates the presence of a tote.”

steps.title: Interpret light blue as “empty rack”
steps.purpose: Apply the correct meaning to light blue so you treat the location as empty.
steps.instruction: If the indicator is light blue, treat the station/location as an “empty rack.”
steps.expected_result: Your working interpretation for that station/location is empty rack.
steps.healthy_condition: The indicator is light blue for the station/location you are checking.
steps.failure_condition: The indicator is not light blue (e.g., it appears dark blue) but you interpret it as empty rack.

actions.label: Mark empty rack
actions.exact_action: If the indicator is light blue, treat it as “empty rack.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “While light blue represents empty rack.”

steps.title: Select the indicated station/location and verify box icon + tote number
steps.purpose: Confirm the indicator interpretation by checking the selection result on the Container Selection screen.
steps.instruction: Select the station/location you are checking. Verify that a box icon appears and that the tote number is shown.
steps.expected_result: After selection, a box icon is displayed and the tote number is shown (when a tote is present per the dark-blue meaning).
steps.healthy_condition: Selection results show a box icon and a tote number.
steps.failure_condition: Selection does not show the expected box icon and tote number for the indicator state you observed (or the indicator meaning appears inconsistent).

actions.label: Select the indicated item
actions.exact_action: If you select it, a box icon will show as well as the tote number.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator color meaning does not match the expected tote-present/empty-rack meaning, stop and escalate to support rather than guessing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “If you select it, a box icon will show as well as the tote number.”

success_criteria: Dark blue station/location is treated as tote present and selection shows a box icon and tote number.
Light blue station/location is treated as empty rack (and you do not proceed by guessing if the selection result contradicts the expected meaning).
healthy_conditions: Blue indicator color is clearly visible as dark blue or light blue for the station/location being checked.
Selection shows a box icon and the tote number.
failure_conditions: Indicator color meaning does not match the expected tote-present/empty-rack meaning.
Selection does not show the expected box icon and tote number.
escalation_guidance: If the indicator color meaning does not match the expected tote-present/empty-rack meaning, stop and escalate to support rather than guessing.
